HUMP! is a live, curated short film festival celebrating sex, love, kink, humor, vulnerability, and human creativity told by real people and experienced together, in theaters, as it was meant to be.

Founded by Dan Savage, HUMP! has spent over two decades proving that intimacy is culture and that audiences are hungry for work that is bold, funny, handmade, and deeply human.
